name: PTT mention provenance diagnostics

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/ptt-mention-provenance-quality.yml'
      - 'scripts/ptt-mention-provenance-boundary.test.mjs'
      - 'web/src/lib/research-v2.ts'
      - 'web/src/lib/ptt-mention-provenance*'
      - 'web/src/lib/ptt-policy*'
      - 'web/src/lib/source-content-semantics*'
      - 'web/package.json'
      - 'web/package-lock.json'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  ptt-mention-provenance-quality:
    name: PTT stock-local evidence and collector diagnostics
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up pinned Node 22
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: '22.14.0'
      - name: Install locked web test dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm --prefix web ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Test PTT local provenance and actual collector boundaries
        run: >-
          node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1
          web/src/lib/ptt-mention-provenance.test.ts
          scripts/ptt-mention-provenance-boundary.test.mjs
          web/src/lib/ptt-policy.test.ts
          web/src/lib/source-content-semantics.test.ts

 s=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',sha+':'+f],text=True)
 print('EXISTING_PIN_FILE',f)
 for line in s.splitlines():
  if 'actions/checkout@' in line or 'actions/setup-node@' in line: print(line.strip())
for f in ['web/src/lib/ptt-mention-provenance.test.ts','scripts/ptt-mention-provenance-boundary.test.mjs','web/src/lib/ptt-policy.test.ts','web/src/lib/source-content-semantics.test.ts']:
 b=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',sha+':'+f])
 print('TEST_PATH_PRESENT',f,len(b))
 print('\\n'.join(x for x in b.decode().splitlines() if x.startswith('import ') or 'PTT_PROVENANCE_TEST_SOURCE' in x))
PY"

對 exact `7af8cba0347010a1d2b007fc8e733ce30faf0ef3` 的 workflow 唯讀核對完成，限定範圍無新 blocker。

- `pull_request` 路徑範圍正確；僅 `contents: read`。
- 兩個 action SHA 與既有 pins 相同；checkout 不保存憑證。
- Node `22.14.0`、locked `npm ci --ignore-scripts`、四個指定測試及 10 分鐘上限正確。
- 未新增 production、secret、model 或 protected 權限。
